description: Run the initial AI takeoff for a new project whose plan PDF was attached with attach_plan_pdf or uploaded by the user on the project page in Portravo. Call preflight_takeoff first and obtain approval for its selected trades and creditsRequired. Set confirmed_trades to the approved selection and max_credits to that approved ceiling (defaults to one for older clients). Uses only existing plan allowance and purchased credits, never billed overage; a changed selection/cost or insufficient balance is refused before starting. The isolated synthetic reviewer retains its bounded one-credit standard fixture. Repeating a call with the same idempotency_key does not charge again. Returns asynchronous progress; use get_takeoff_status until done, then get_takeoff for source-linked human review. A completed run is not a bid-ready estimate. Failed provider runs refund the reservation; existing review work cannot be overwritten.
name: run_takeoff
title: Extract a construction plan takeoff
